[[Iquique]] | capacity = 13,171 | chairman = Césare Rossi | coach = [[Miguel Ponce]] | league = [[Chilean Primera División|Primera División]] | season = [[2024 Chilean Primera División|2024]] | position = Primera División, 3rd of 16 | website = {{URL|http://www.clubdeportesiquique.com/}} | pattern_la1 = _iquique20h|pattern_b1=_iquique20h|pattern_ra1=_iquique20h | leftarm1 = 5EDBFF|body1=5EDBFF|rightarm1=5EDBFF|shorts1=5EDBFF|socks1=5EDBFF | pattern_la2 = _iquique20a|pattern_b2=_iquique20a|pattern_ra2=_iquique20a | leftarm2 = 000000|body2=000000|rightarm2=000000|shorts2=000000|socks2=000000 }} '''Club de Deportes Iquique S.A.D.P.'''{{cite web|url = http://www.clubdeportesiquique.cl/#detalle_noticia-425|title = UNÁNIME: Desde ahora es Club de Deportes Iquique|work = Deportes Iquique.cl|date = 7 November 2010|url-status = dead|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150316125716/http://www.clubdeportesiquique.cl/#detalle_noticia-425|archive-date = 16 March 2015}} is a Chilean professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Iquique]], currently playing in the [[Chilean Primera División]]. Founded in 1978, the club's home stadium is the [[Estadio Tierra de Campeones]], which has a 13,171 capacity. Iquique has spent 19 seasons in the Primera División, its longest spell lasting ten years (1980–90). The team has spent 13 seasons in [[Primera B (Chile)|Primera B]] and four in the third-tier [[Tercera División de Chile|Tercera División]]. Among its titles, Iquique has won three [[Copa Chile]] titles ([[1980 Copa Polla Gol|1980]], [[2010 Copa Chile Bicentenario|2010]] and [[2013–14 Copa Chile|2013–14]]).{{cite web |url =http://www.anfp.cl/noticia/20822/deportes-iquique-se-corono-campeon-de-la-copa-chile-mts-20132014 |title = Deportes Iquique se coronó campeón de la Copa Chile MTS 2013–2014 | work = [[ANFP]] | date = 17 April 2014 | access-date = 26 July 2015}} They have a local rivalry with [[San Marcos de Arica]], disputing the derby since early 1980s.{{cite web | url = http://www.cdf.cl/cdf/site/artic/20130510/pags/20130510153513.html | title = Clásicos del recuerdo: San Marcos vs. Deportes Iquique | work = [[Canal del Fútbol (Chile)|CDF]] | date = 10 May 2013 | access-date = 26 July 2015 | archive-date = 4 March 2016 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160304052315/http://www.cdf.cl/cdf/site/artic/20130510/pags/20130510153513.html | url-status = dead }} ==History== The team was founded on 21 May 1978 by the merger of Cavancha and Estrella de Chile.{{cite web |url =http://www.anfp.cl/noticia/21084/club-deportes-iquique-celebra-36-anos-de-historia |title = Club Deportes Iquique celebra 36 años de historia | work = [[ANFP]] | date = 21 April 2014 | access-date = 26 July 2015}} The following year Iquique competed in the [[Segunda División de Chile|Segunda División]], winning it and securing promotion to the [[Campeonato Nacional (Chile)|Campeonato Nacional]].{{cite web | url = http://www.elhincha.cl/noticias/deportes-iquique-la-historia-de-los-dragones-celestes/ | title = Deportes Iquique, la historia de los Dragones Celestes | work = Elhincha.cl | date = 23 February 2014 | access-date = 1 August 2015 | archive-date = 23 September 2015 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150923235406/http://www.elhincha.cl/noticias/deportes-iquique-la-historia-de-los-dragones-celestes/ | url-status = dead }}{{cite web |url =https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ku-LVfw8dTg |title = Deportes Iquique 2 – Ferroviarios 1 (1979) | access-date = 1 August 2015}} In its first season at top level, the club finished in 14th place out of eighteen teams and won the [[1980 Copa Polla Gol|Copa Polla Gol]], beating [[Colo-Colo]] in the final at the [[Estadio Nacional Julio Martínez Prádanos|Estadio Nacional]].{{cite web |url =http://www.estrellaiquique.cl/prontus4_nots/site/artic/20090404/pags/20090404001009.html |title = Iquique quiere revivir la historia | publisher = Estrella de Iquique | date = 4 April 2009 | access-date = 1 August 2015}}{{cite web |url =https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yKWNuUXrvFQ |title = Deportes Iquique campeón Copa Polla Gol 1980 | access-date = 1 August 2015}} Between 1981 and 1987, Iquique remained in mid-table positions. In 1988, they reached the qualifying stages of the [[1989 Copa Libertadores]] after finishing in third place in the league. However, they lost to Colo-Colo in the final of the qualification tournament.{{cite web |url = http://www.cdf.cl/cdf/site/artic/20150204/pags/20150204123124.html |title = La receta de Don Nelson para un Iquique glorioso | publisher = [[Canal del Fútbol (Chile)|CDF]] | date = 27 August 2014 | access-date = 1 August 2015}} That season, [[Juan José Oré]] was the tournament's leading goalscorer with eighteen goals.{{cite web |url = http://depor.pe/futbol-peruano/juan-jose-ore-10-datos-tecnico-campeon-nanjing-2014-1023515 |title = Juan José Oré: 10 datos del técnico campeón en Nanjing 2014 | publisher = Depor.pe | date = 27 August 2014 | access-date = 1 August 2015}} In 1991, following a poor campaign where the team finished in the bottom of the table, they were relegated to the second division. They returned to the top flight for one season in 1993, and again for two seasons in 1997.{{cite web |url = http://pasionceleste.cl/wp_Sitio02/index.php/2015/05/21/feliz-cumpleanos-dragon-historia-en-37-datos/ |title = Feliz cumpleaños Dragón: Historia en 37 datos | publisher = [[La Tercera]] | date = 29 September 2009 | access-date = 1 August 2015}}{{cite web |url = http://www.latercera.com/contenido/82_71737_9.shtml |title = Primera B: Iquique se "codea con los grandes" tras 10 años | publisher = [[La Tercera]] | date = 10 November 2008 | access-date = 1 August 2015}} However, in 2002, the club was relegated to the third division and then declared bankruptcy. It was relaunched as Municipal Iquique.{{cite web |url = http://diario.latercera.com/2012/09/29/01/contenido/deportes/4-119417-9-iquique-el-nuevo-grande-de-provincia.shtml |title = Iquique, el nuevo grande de provincia | publisher = [[La Tercera]] | date = 29 September 2009 | access-date = 1 August 2015}}{{cite web |url =http://www.estrellaiquique.cl/prontus4_nots/site/artic/20100309/pags/20100309004004.html |title = Rossi busca cambiar nombre a Municipal | publisher = Estrella Iquique | date = 9 March 2010 | access-date = 1 August 2015}} During its four-year presence in the third division, the club saw the rise of Chilean international [[Edson Puch]], a key player in their title win of 2006.{{cite web |url =http://www.emol.com/noticias/deportes/2007/01/06/241333/tercera-division-iquique-se-corono-campeon-y-vuelve-a-la-primera-b.html |title = Tercera División: Iquique se coronó campéon y vuelve a la Primera B | publisher = Emol | date = 6 January 2007 | access-date = 1 August 2015}}{{cite web |url =http://futboliquique.blogspot.cl/2007/01/iquique-campeon_07.html |title = Iquique Campeón | work = Fútbol Iquique | date = 7 January 2007 | access-date = 1 August 2015}} Two years later, Iquique reached its fourth promotion to the top division, beating [[Coquimbo Unido]] in the promotion playoffs.{{cite web |url =http://www.mercurioantofagasta.cl/prontus4_noticias/site/artic/20081109/pags/20081109000553.html |title = Iquique vuelve a Primera | publisher = Mercurio Antofagasta | date = 9 November 2008 | access-date = 1 August 2015}} During the [[2009 Torneo Apertura (Chile)|2009 Apertura]],{{cite web |url =http://www.lanacion.cl/noticias/deportes/municipal-iquique-vencio-a-deportes-la-serena-y-clasifico-a-playoffs/2009-05-17/011031.html |title = Municipal Iquique venció a Deportes La Serena y clasificó a playoffs | publisher = [[La Nación (Chile)|La Nación]] | date = 17 May 2009 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} Puch was transferred to [[Club Universidad de Chile|Universidad de Chile]] and [[Cristian Bogado]] to Colo-Colo. The club only obtained nine points during the second half of the season, and finished bottom of the table to be relegated to the second division.{{cite web |url =http://www.ellanquihue.cl/prontus4_nots/site/artic/20091108/pags/20091108174120.html |title = Iquique desciende, Rangers y Curicó esperarán veredicto de la ANFP | publisher = [[El Llanquihue]] | date = 8 November 2009 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} In 2010, Iquique won its third second division title{{cite web |url =http://www.cooperativa.cl/noticias/deportes/futbol/primera-b/iquique-se-corono-campeon-de-la-primera-b-y-volvio-a-la-division-de-honor/2010-11-21/191624.html |title = Iquique se coronó campeón de la Primera B y volvió a la división de honor | publisher = Radio Cooperativa | date = 21 November 2010 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} and its second [[2010 Copa Chile Bicentenario|Copa Chile]] title,{{cite web |url =http://www.cdf.cl/cdf/site/artic/20101208/pags/20101208180021.html |title = M. Iquique derrotó a D. Concepción y es campeón de Copa Chile | publisher = [[Canal del Fútbol (Chile)|CDF]] | date = 8 December 2010 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} securing qualification for the [[2011 Copa Sudamericana]]. In their first ever continental tournament, the club was eliminated in the preliminary stage by [[CDUC|Universidad Católica]].{{cite web |url =http://www.puranoticia.cl/front/contenido/2011/09/14/noticia-15452.php |title = Iquique y Universidad Católica empatan sin goles en el norte por la Copa Sudamericana | publisher = Puranoticia.cl | date = 14 September 2011 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} The team finished eleventh in the league. In 2012, Iquique participated in the Copa Sudamericana for the second consecutive time,{{cite web |url =http://www.cooperativa.cl/noticias/deportes/futbol/deportes-iquique/deportes-iquique-clasifico-a-la-copa-sudamericana-2012/2012-05-11/221221.html |title = Deportes Iquique clasificó a la Copa Sudamericana 2012 | publisher = [[Radio Cooperativa]] | date = 12 May 2012 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} qualifying with third place in the [[2012 Torneo Apertura (Chile)|2012 Apertura]]{{cite web |url =http://www.soychile.cl/Iquique/Deportes/2012/05/19/92475/Deportes-Iquique-salen-abrochar-el-tercer-lugar-del-Apertura-2012.aspx |title = Deportes Iquique goleó 4 a 1 a Unión San Felipe y abrochó el tercer lugar | publisher = Soy Chile | date = 19 May 2012 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} which saw the return of Puch and Bogado, signings including [[Rodrigo Díaz (footballer)|Rodrigo Díaz]] and the emergence of [[Álvaro Ramos (footballer)|Álvaro Ramos]] as a strong player. However, once again the team were eliminated at the preliminary stage, this time by Uruguay's [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] after a 4–2 aggregate loss.{{cite web |url =http://www.emol.com/noticias/deportes/2012/08/14/555725/iquique-pago-caro-sus-errores-y-fue-eliminado-por-nacional-en-la-copa-sudamericana.html |title = Iquique pagó caros sus errores y fue eliminado en la Sudamericana | publisher = Emol | date = 14 August 2012 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} That season, the club qualified for the Copa Libertadores after finishing third in the league.{{cite web |url =http://www.cdf.cl/cdf/site/artic/20130130/pags/20130130004318.html |title = ¡El chumbeque será más dulce! Deportes Iquique clasificado a la fase de grupos de la Copa Libertadores | publisher = [[Canal del Fútbol (Chile)|CDF]] | date = 30 January 2013 | access-date = 2 August 2015}}{{cite web |url =http://www.cooperativa.cl/noticias/deportes/futbol/copa-libertadores/revise-a-los-equipos-ya-clasificados-a-la-copa-libertadores-2013/2012-11-09/125002.html |title = Revise a los equipos ya clasificados a la Copa Libertadores 2013 | publisher = [[Radio Cooperativa]] | date = 9 November 2012 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} After beating Mexican side [[Club León|León]] in the first stage, Iquique finished bottom of their group in the next stage.{{cite web |url =http://www.latercera.com/noticia/deportes/2013/05/656-523425-9-anfp-confirma-torneo-sin-playoffs-y-con-liguilla-para-definir-cupos.shtml |title = ANFP confirma torneo sin playoffs y con liguilla para Copa Chile|Copa Chile]],{{cite web |url =http://www.chilevision.cl/noticias/chvdeportes/futbol-nacional/deportes-iquique-gano-su-tercera-copa-chile-ante-huachipato/2014-04-17/001357.html |title = Deportes Iquique ganó su tercera Copa Chile ante Huachipato | publisher = [[Chilevisión]] | date = 17 April 2014 | access-date = 1 August 2015}} qualifying again for the Copa Sudamericana. For the third time, it was eliminated at the preliminary stage, with a loss to [[Club Universitario|Universitario de Sucre]] from Bolivia.{{cite web |url =https://www.ferplei.com/2014/08/en-vivo-de-deportes-iquique-vs-universitario-de-sucre-por-copa-sudamericana/ |title = Triunfo de Iquique fue insuficiente para eliminar a Universitario de Sucre [Fotos de Video] | publisher = Ferplei.com | date = 26 August 2014 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} In the [[2014–15 Chilean Primera División season|2014–15 season]], Católica lost the title to [[Cobresal]] on the final matchday after drawing 3–3 with Iquique, after Iquique had been losing 3–0 at half time.{{cite web |url =http://www.espn.cl/futbol/cronica?id=411095 |title = Católica igualó con Iquique y le entregó el título a Cobresal | publisher = [[ESPN]] | work = ESPN Chile | date = 25 April 2015 | access-date = 2 August 2015}} During the [[2015–16 Campeonato Nacional (Chile) season|2015–16 season]] they finished tenth in the annual table. ==Stadium== The [[:es:Estadio Municipal de Cavancha|Estadio Municipal de Cavancha]] is currently the home stadium of the club. The stadium holds 3,300 spectators and was built in 1933. It has been home to Deportes Iquique since the club's founding, in 1978, until 1993, and from 2016 until at least 2019.
